{{Leo}}
Leo 24 is the 248th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 24th day of Leo, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 36, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 9宮24日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 248|Chapter 248]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q153715}}.
